BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to enforcement authority over natural resourceinfractions; and adding a new section to chapter 7.84 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.84 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By agreement under the interlocal cooperation act, chapter 39.34RCW, the state parks and recreation commission, the commissioner ofpublic lands, and the director of the department of fish and wildlifeare each authorized to delegate and accept enforcement authority overnatural resource infractions to or from the other agencies.
